title: Permission Denied
summary: Inspect and correct a file permission mode.
description: Permissions define which users may read, write, or execute a file. The `briefing.txt` file starts with intentionally restrictive permissions. Use `stat` or `ls -l` to inspect the mode, then set it to owner read/write and group read (`640`).
learning_objectives: Read symbolic and octal permission modes
Use chmod on one specific file

workspace_seed.locked/briefing.txt: This briefing is synthetic lab material. Correct access mode: owner rw, group r, others none.

offline_hints.title: Think about the concept
offline_hints.content: First inspect the file mode; do not guess what the three digit groups mean.

offline_hints.title: Investigate this area
offline_hints.content: Use `ls -l locked/briefing.txt` or `stat`. The target mode is 640, meaning owner rw, group r, others none.

offline_hints.title: Guided route
offline_hints.content: Run `chmod 640 locked/briefing.txt`, then verify using `stat -c %a locked/briefing.txt`. The validator checks the real mode and expected owner.

completion_explanation: You completed Permission Denied. Review the evidence, compare the observed result with the expected state, and explain why it matters in a real defensive workflow.

network_requirements.description: No network interface is required for this mission.
